entry.summary: Visitor permit needed before arrival (Entry Control Ordinance 2022): GBP 250 from 1 July 2026 and GBP 275 from 1 July 2027, valid 40 days. Apply at least 8 days ahead at eta.entry.gov.gs; nothing is approved within 3 days of arrival.
entry.next_check: Confirm with South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands's government.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. GSGSSI Visitor Code of Conduct ashore: follow staff instructions and stay with your group. Keep at least 5 m from wildlife, 10 m from nesting birds, 25 m from displaying albatross and 50 m from giant petrels. Don't touch, feed or collect anything. Clean boots and gear before every landing (biosecurity), and bring no fresh food ashore.

culture-cycles.public_holidays: No public holiday calendar of its own in the machine data. There is no permanent resident population; government and research staff keep their own calendars.
culture-cycles.note: Ask the Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands about any closures for the visitor season.

laws.rule: Follow the territory government's biosecurity protocols; breaches can bring a fine or prison.

Entering or approaching within 200 metres of the former whaling stations (Prince Olav Harbour, Leith Harbour, Stromness, Husvik) is prohibited unless directed otherwise by the Commissioner's Office or the Government Officer at King Edward Point.
